arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Ms. Blatt argued that the default civil standard is preponderance of the evidence.
Ms. Brown asserted that Congress intended a preponderance standard for civil actions.
Ms. Bateman stated that the judiciary traditionally sets proof standards when statutes are silent.
